name: Panda Express Map
short_description: MP-focused map overhaul: consolidates non-European countries to reduce compute while keeping economies intact; releases all releasable nations and subjects in Europe; splits Iberia, France, Italy, the British Isles, Bohemia, Hungary, the Balkans, Anatolia, North Africa, Egypt and the Levant into regional bosses, mini bosses and many smaller countries for a more balanced multiplayer experience; removes cores on land split away from a country; redistributes some gold and silver mines in Iberia and France.
